description: IP.21 tags from IP_AnalogDef and archived samples from the HISTORY table, optionally sampled at a requested period.
unverified: IP_AnalogDef.LO_LIMIT and IP_AnalogDef.HI_LIMIT: some IP.21 sites expose limits as LO_LIMIT/HI_LIMIT, others as RANGE_LO/RANGE_HI.
HISTORY.PERIOD: SQLplus accepts a history request period, but older versions use a REQUEST clause instead of a PERIOD comparison.
HISTORY latest query: ORDER BY TS DESC LIMIT 1 may need FIRST 1 or a site view on IP.21 SQLplus.
QUALITY ranges: IP.21 quality is site-configured; the shipped map treats 0 good, 1 uncertain and 2..255 bad.

browse.sql: SELECT NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENG_UNITS FROM IP_AnalogDef ORDER BY NAME

metadata.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION, ENG_UNITS, LO_LIMIT, HI_LIMIT FROM IP_AnalogDef WHERE NAME = ?

history.sql: SELECT TS, VALUE, QUALITY FROM HISTORY WHERE NAME = ? AND TS >= ? AND TS <= ? ORDER BY TS
history.period_sql: SELECT TS, VALUE, QUALITY FROM HISTORY WHERE NAME = ? AND TS >= ? AND TS <= ? AND PERIOD = ? ORDER BY TS

latest.sql: SELECT TS, VALUE, QUALITY FROM HISTORY WHERE NAME = ? ORDER BY TS DESC LIMIT 1
